title: Market data refreshed from self-contained PSX close and market-cap publisher
points: The market-data publisher now lives inside psxgpt-pipeline instead of depending on legacy infrastructure code. It fetches PSX DPS EOD rows directly and uses the documented payload shape [timestamp, close, volume, open], so closing_price is the true close rather than the open field.

Production market_data was refreshed for close, total shares, and market cap. Deprecated derived valuation fields such as PE, PB, dividend yield, enterprise value, and P/E basis fields are cleared on refreshed rows instead of being treated as authoritative.

Serve routing and lane instructions now use market_data for direct market fields only: closing price, shares, market cap, ticker enumeration, and 52-week fields where present. Derived valuation metrics must combine market cap with sourced financial-statement or ratio inputs.
Pipeline QC now validates D1 closing_price, total_shares, and market_cap against live PSX DPS/company-page inputs instead of comparing stale P/E and dividend-yield calculations.
